answer: RE-BASED.  Three parts fit only the re-based window and one fits both; none fits section 1 alone.  The board is on the re-based datum and every mechanical region must be read with the +1.000 mm applied.
consequence: BOSS1's HOLE was the one object on this board that never took the re-base: it sat at doc x = 40.000 while its own BOSS1_KEEPOUT sat at 38.750 .. 43.250, the re-based value, centred on 41.000.  BOSS2 and BOSS2_KEEPOUT were both already re-based and both correct.  D-758 read the section-1 coordinates as current, moved both keep-outs onto the PRE-REBASE centres and moved BOSS2 1.000 mm west; this decision reverts all of that and moves the one object that was actually wrong.
